topic: Data integration scope for airport analytics
summary_markdown:
The client provided feedback on data requirements for the Traffic page and Campaign Manager. It was decided to exclude the "Education Level" category from this data set, as it is unavailable from Kido and inconsistent across facilities.

Regarding the Airport Analytics page, the suggestion to include demographic charts using the original format was postponed. While acknowledged as necessary for future locations (e.g., subway, other airports), it is not a priority for the current Brasilia Airport implementation.

The team discussed merging data sources: dropping "Education Level" and aligning remaining metrics with Kido's structure. The timeline for implementing these changes was set for before the end of next week, though efforts will be made to deliver sooner.

Separately, discussions covered integrating `citydata` for Mexico, noting that it differs from the data used for Brazil. This integration is viewed as a positive development for future regional deployments.
decisions: Exclude "Education Level" category from Traffic page and Campaign Manager data sets.
Postpone demographic chart inclusion in Airport Analytics for Brasilia Airport, prioritizing current scope.
Target completion of data adjustments (merging metrics) by the end of next week.
action_items: Continue work on integrating `citydata` for Mexico and other regions.
